notes: Verified S-tier discoveries from primary venue sources: Christian McBride & Ursa Major make the new project's Japan debut at Blue Note Tokyo, and Pat Metheny brings the current Side-Eye III+ project to Strathmore in the DMV.

events.subtitle: Japan debut of the new Ursa Major project
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Christian McBride & Ursa Major on September 16-18, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The venue describes the engagement as the Japan debut of McBride's newly formed Ursa Major project, pairing him with Nicole Glover, Ely Perlman, Mike King and Savannah Harris.

sources.note: Official event page confirming September 16-18 dates, both daily set times, full lineup, Japan-debut framing and web reservations.
Exact Apple Music album-container page for More Is - Single by Christian McBride & Ursa Major.

provenance.note: Dates, showtimes, lineup, venue, Japan-debut context and reservation status verified from Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page; listening recommendation verified on Apple Music.

en.why_it_matters: McBride's stature alone would make this notable, but the S rating comes from the specific context: Ursa Major is a current project built around a younger generation of improvisers, and Blue Note Tokyo explicitly presents these nights as the group's Japan debut. The combination of McBride's bass authority, groove and mentorship with saxophone, guitar, piano and drums makes this a living project rather than a retrospective master-class booking.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect one of the six sets if in Tokyo: the Japan debut of this exact new group is substantially more distinctive than a routine McBride residency, though it does not by itself require a transpacific trip.

es.why_it_matters: La estatura de McBride ya haría importante la fecha, pero el nivel S viene del contexto específico: Ursa Major es un proyecto actual construido alrededor de una generación más joven de improvisadores, y Blue Note Tokyo presenta explícitamente estas noches como el debut del grupo en Japón. La autoridad de McBride en el bajo y el groove, combinada con saxofón, guitarra, piano y batería, convierte la fecha en un proyecto vivo y no en una retrospectiva de maestro consagrado.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Hay que proteger uno de los seis sets si estás en Tokio: el debut japonés de esta formación exacta es mucho más singular que una residencia rutinaria de McBride, aunque por sí solo no exige cruzar el Pacífico.

events.subtitle: Side-Eye III+ Tour
events.factual_description: Strathmore presents Pat Metheny's Side-Eye III+ Tour at The Music Center on Thursday, September 17, 2026 at 8:00 PM. The current quartet pairs Metheny with Chris Fishman on piano/keyboards, Joe Dyson on drums and Jermaine Paul on bass; Strathmore describes Side-Eye as an ongoing setting for exchange between Metheny and emerging improvisers.

sources.note: Official event page confirming September 17, 2026 at 8:00 PM, venue, Side-Eye III+ billing, current quartet personnel and ticket availability.
Exact Apple Music page for the 2026 Side-Eye III+ album.

provenance.note: Date, time, venue, tour identity and quartet personnel verified from Strathmore's exact event page; current-project listening recommendation verified on Apple Music.

en.why_it_matters: Metheny is a living master with one of jazz guitar's most identifiable voices, but this is not a catalog-retrospective date. Side-Eye III+ is his current 2026 project, and the quartet format deliberately puts his guitar language into exchange with younger improvisers. That combination of instrumental identity, active repertoire and intergenerational improvisation makes the local Strathmore date unusually strong.
en.trip_verdict: S local. Protect September 17 in the DMV: this is exactly the kind of living-master performance worth crossing the region for, with a current band and current music rather than a nostalgia package.

es.why_it_matters: Metheny es un maestro vivo con una de las voces más reconocibles de la guitarra jazz, pero ésta no es una fecha de retrospectiva. Side-Eye III+ es su proyecto actual de 2026, y el formato de cuarteto pone deliberadamente su lenguaje de guitarra en diálogo con improvisadores más jóvenes. Esa combinación de identidad instrumental, repertorio vigente e improvisación intergeneracional vuelve especialmente fuerte la fecha local de Strathmore.
es.trip_verdict: S local. Hay que proteger el 17 de septiembre en el DMV: es exactamente el tipo de actuación de un maestro vivo por la que vale la pena cruzar la región, con banda y música actuales en vez de un paquete nostálgico.
